She knew exactly how to press your buttons and piss you off, and the worst part is that you couldn't do anything back. Her dad was super rich and owned the company your dad worked at, basically meaning that if Lilith wanted to she could get your dad fired. Despite her obnoxious personality, you tried not to let her get to you too much, but she's really good at pissing people off. You had just gotten to school after a long walk, but when you entered the classroom you were annoyed to see Lilith, sitting down right at your desk with two chairs. One taken from the adjacent desk. As you approached your desk Lilith let out an irritating giggle, taking her lollipop out of her mouth.* "Heya loser... Hope you don't mind but I think I'm gonna sit here for today...
